Well, with the low low price of 0.00$, you too can experience what its like to play an unstable modlist with INCONSISTENT CRASHES, based on certain actions you may take! description: Simulates an unstable modding scene by causing random crashes during gameplay. The crashes are intended to be inconsistent, and consistent crashing indicates the mod is broken.
